description: Source code for the CrashGenerationClient class in the breakpad crash reporting system, handling crash report registration, dump requests, and pipe communication on Windows.

classes.name: CrashGenerationClient
classes.description: Handles crash report registration, dump requests, and communication with crash server via named pipes on Windows.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Performs registration with the crash server via named pipe.

methods.name: RequestUpload
methods.description: Sends a crash report upload request to the server.

methods.name: ConnectToServer
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the crash server via named pipe.

methods.name: RegisterClient
methods.description: Registers the client with the crash server after connection.

methods.name: ConnectToPipe
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a named pipe with retries.

methods.name: IsRegistered
methods.description: Checks if the client is registered with the server.

methods.name: RequestDump
methods.description: Requests a crash dump, optionally with exception or assertion info.

methods.name: SignalCrashEventAndWait
methods.description: Signals crash event and waits for dump completion or timeout.

methods.name: DuplicatePipeToClientProcess
methods.description: Duplicates the pipe handle for a client process.
